subject: Contract navigator: MAP, legal redlines, and signature playbook
messages:
From: Alicia Porter <alicia.porter@novaforge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract navigator: MAP, legal redlines, and signature playbook

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Leadership wants a tight mutual action plan (MAP) and a clear sequencing for the MSA/DPA/order form so procurement can slot signature into their quarter-end cadence. Two asks from my side:

1) Can you send a short MAP we can share with our procurement and legal teams (high level milestones, owners, and target dates)?
2) Are there specific order-form dependencies (e.g., escrow, entitlements, per-region data terms) that will hold the signature until legal signs off?

If you can share a draft MAP and a simple table of dependencies today, procurement will try to align their gates.

Attachments: none

— Alicia
Alicia Porter
Head of Platform Partnerships, Novaforge AI
alicia.porter@novaforge.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Porter <alicia.porter@novaforge.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract navigator: MAP, legal redlines, and signature playbook

Alicia —

Appreciate the clarity. Draft MAP attached (MAP-draft-jb-v1.docx) — short runway with owners and gating checkboxes. Key points up front:

- Target signature window: 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-21 (procurement requested a mid-Oct slot).
- Critical dependency: DPA review + regional data residency addendum (if required) before order form can be countersigned.
- Escrow only required if Novaforge requests source-escrow; not standard — we can provision an escrow addendum but it adds ~2 weeks for legal negotiation.
- Billing/PO flow: procurement needs a fully executed MSA + order form; billing can begin on the order form effective date.

Proposed immediate next steps (short):
1) Novaforge legal to send any MSA/DPA redlines this week.
2) Redwood legal (Karthik) will triage and return a single consolidated redline + comment matrix within 48 hours of receipt.
3) Procurement aligns purchase order and schedules signature week; if escrow requested, both legal teams estimate 10 business days.

Ive looped Grace for onboarding/acceptance criteria and Karthik on legal sequencing.

Attachment: MAP-draft-jb-v1.docx (3 pages) — contains milestone table and acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cell: +1 415-555-0211
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Porter <alicia.porter@novaforge.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract navigator: MAP, legal redlines, and signature playbook

Alicia —

Quick note from adoption/CS side: to avoid scope-driven delays I recommend we lock acceptance criteria now. Suggested minimum acceptance for pilot:

- Data ingest of up to 250k tokens/day for 30 days without service-impacting errors.
- Performance SLO: median latency under 450ms for common generation flows.
- Success criteria for eval: 3 representative prompts with no regression vs baseline.

If Novaforge wants accelerated onboarding, we can schedule a pre-go-live technical check two days before the order form effective date.

Happy to sync on Monday for any clarifications.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Porter <alicia.porter@novaforge.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract navigator: MAP, legal redlines, and signature playbook

Alicia / Jordan —

Thanks for the MAP. I reviewed the draft and sketched focused redlines; attached are two artifacts: 1) MSA-redlines-karthik.pdf (annotated redline, key change calls), and 2) DPA-summary-notes.txt (plain-language summary of data residency, subprocessors, and deletion timelines).

High-level comments:
- We can accept most commercial terms but need to tighten data deletion and auditability language.
- Regional addendum: if Novaforge requires EU-only processing for specific workloads, well add a short addendum (typically adds 5–7 business days).
- Escrow: not standard; if requested, we charge an escrow setup fee and require a separate addendum (estimate +2 weeks).

To speed things up: please indicate which controls are deal blockers (e.g., EU-only, escrow) so well prioritize. If nothing is blockers, I can propose a countersigned MSA + tracked DPA notes within 48 hours.

Attachments: MSA-redlines-karthik.pdf, DPA-summary-notes.txt

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Burns <sarah.burns@novaforge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Porter <alicia.porter@novaforge.com>, legal@novaforge.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract navigator: MAP, legal redlines, and signature playbook

Jordan / Karthik —

Attached is Novaforges consolidated redline set (Novaforge-redlines-consolidated.pdf). Two urgent notes from our legal side:

- We want the DPA to specify a 30-day notice period for data export on termination (deal blocker unless clarified).
- Were requesting an escrow addendum for the model weights used in the integration; procurement flagged this as high priority.

Procurement is holding a signature window: week of 2026-10-18 is preferred. If escrow is required we understand there will be a delay; however, Novaforge legal asks Redwood to provide an escrow timeline estimate today so we can communicate to procurement.

Attachment: Novaforge-redlines-consolidated.pdf

— Sarah Burns
Senior Counsel, Novaforge AI
legal@novaforge.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Burns <sarah.burns@novaforge.com>, Alicia Porter <alicia.porter@novaforge.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract navigator: MAP, legal redlines, and signature playbook

Sarah —

Thanks for the consolidated redlines and the callout on escrow. Quick response and proposed plan:

1) Escrow: we can provide an escrow addendum; setup + negotiation typically adds 8–12 business days depending on the third-party escrow vendor. If Novaforge confirms escrow is mandatory, well treat that as a blocker and start vendor engagement immediately.
2) DPA: Karthik will propose tightened deletion language that retains the 30-day export notice but clarifies export assistance commitments (I expect the draft back to you in the next 24 business hours).
3) Signature window: if escrow is not required, we can target week of 2026-10-18 as requested. If escrow is required, realistic signature shifts to week of 2026-11-01.

Immediate asks from Novaforge to keep to the mid-Oct cadence:
- Confirm whether escrow is mandatory or optional by EOD tomorrow.
- Confirm any EU-only processing workloads that require the regional addendum.

Ill also upload the current MAP draft and a one-page sequencing table to the shared Drive (link below) so procurement has a single reference.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPdraft
DocuSign placeholder: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABC-123-NF

Thanks — Ill stand by to triage.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
